mapper.sql: f.id, f.user_id, f.feedback_type, f.title, f.content, f.contact_info, f.status, f.priority, f.system_version, f.device_info, f.ip_address, f.screenshot_url, f.create_date, f.update_date, f.process_user_id, f.process_date, f.process_comment, u.user_name, pu.user_name AS process_user_name, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM byai_attach_file af WHERE af.table_name = 'byai_system_feedback' AND af.table_pk_value = f.id AND af.state = '00A' ) AS attachment_count
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM byai_system_feedback f LEFT JOIN po_users u ON u.user_id = f.user_id LEFT JOIN po_users pu ON pu.user_id = f.process_user_id
AND f.feedback_type = #{qo.feedbackType}
AND LOWER(f.status) = LOWER(#{qo.status})
AND ( UPPER(f.title) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{qo.keyword}), '%') OR UPPER(f.content) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{qo.keyword}), '%') )
AND UPPER(f.title) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{qo.title}), '%')
AND UPPER(f.content) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{qo.content}), '%')
ORDER BY CASE LOWER(COALESCE(f.status, 'pending')) WHEN 'pending' THEN 1 WHEN 'processing' THEN 2 WHEN 'resolved' THEN 3 WHEN 'closed' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, f.create_date DESC, f.id DESC

SELECT
FROM byai_system_feedback f LEFT JOIN po_users u ON u.user_id = f.user_id LEFT JOIN po_users pu ON pu.user_id = f.process_user_id WHERE f.id = #{id}
